text:
sec-oncall: Heads-up: incident P2 1: stale SSO sessions observed for multiple service accounts after IdP connector config drift. Potential long-lived session tokens issued via SAML provider. We need org-wide remediation.
sec-oncall: Impact: temporary elevated access for some service accounts until sessions expire. No confirmed malicious use yet. Required actions below.
idp-admin: Confirmed: our last IdP rollout (2026-03-20 02:00 UTC) unintentionally disabled assertion expiration enforcement for the `redwood-saml` connector. SAML AssertionConsumerService accepted SessionNotOnOrAfter-less checks. Oops.
sso-bot: automated alert: high rate of "keep-alive" assertions from edge-ip 34.120.10.22 matching service-account pattern svc-* between 02:05-02:30 UTC.
alice: ack. Which service accounts are affected? Any user-facing sessions?
sec-oncall: preliminary list: svc-deploy, svc-ci, svc-monitoring, svc-metrics. No human user sessions flagged yet, but we are treating all federated sessions as in-scope.
bob: starting a forced logout for federated sessions via IdP API: `/idp/admin/logout?tenant=redwood&filter=federated` 30s ETA. Will follow up with session token revocation for each relying party.
infra: pausing federation-based token issuance: disabled `allow_federation=true` on the connector; new token issuance blocked.
idp-admin: rolling back the faulty change to enforce `SessionNotOnOrAfter` checks. Deploying fix to IdP cluster now.
eng-manager: need communications plan: will this break current deploy pipelines or staff logins?
sec-oncall: short-term break: deploy pipelines using SSO-backed service accounts will need re-login and new tokens. We will create exemptions for emergency deploys via short-lived API tokens. Notify SRE and CI owners.
support: opening a high-priority incident ticket and a status page update draft. Draft: "We detected an IdP configuration issue impacting some automated integrations. We are revoking federated sessions and rotating related tokens. No customer data exposure detected."
legal: loop me in after containment for compliance note. We may need to record timeline for auditors.
alice: command I'll run to list sessions: `idpctl sessions list --filter "principal:svc-*" --since 2026-03-20T02:00Z` and then revoke: `idpctl sessions revoke <session-id>`
sec-oncall: good. Also run: `aws sts get-session-token --serial-number arn:aws:iam::123456:mfa/sso --token-code <code>` is not needed now; we're focusing on SAML assertions. For AWS roles assumed via SAML, we will run `aws iam update-assume-role-policy` to tighten conditions if necessary.
bob: revoked 74 federated sessions for svc-deploy and svc-ci. Rotating any persistent API keys those services use. New keys will be stored in Vault and flagged as 'rotated-after-idp-incident'.
infra: toggled CI to fallback mode: temporary deploy API token enabled for `svc-deploy` with expiration 2h. Documented in runbook.
sso-bot: IdP config rollback deployed to two nodes. Health: ok. Assertion validation now enforced.
sec-oncall: next steps checklist: 1) Revoke all federated sessions for svc-* (in progress). 2) Rotate associated persistent keys and update Vault. 3) Run audit: check last 24h executions of critical pipelines for anomalous behavior. 4) Update connector config tests to include assertion expiry validation. 5) Postmortem and exec note.
alice: running audit: `splunk query: index=auth "AssumeRoleWithSAML" OR "SAMLResponse" | stats count by principal, src_ip`
eng-manager: please prepare a 1-paragraph exec summary once containment is done. I will notify CTO and ops leadership.
sec-oncall: containment status: sessions revoked, IdP fix applied, token rotations underway, CI fallback enabled, audit started. ETA for full containment and verification: 2h.
support: status page updated: "Investigating - IdP connector issue affecting automated integrations. Mitigations underway."
legal: noted; preserving logs and audit trail.
alice: found one anomalous assumption: svc-monitoring assumed role from unfamiliar IP 198.51.100.45 at 02:12 UTC. Escalating to forensics.
sec-oncall: forensics assigned to bob + idp-admin. If you have any suspicious artifacts, upload to the secure case folder and ping @sec-oncall.
bob: forensics: captured authn request and assertion blobs, collecting STS assume-role logs.
eng-manager: thanks all. Quick ask: add an automated test to our IaC PR checks to validate `assertion_expiry_enforced=true` for saml connectors.
infra: creating PR now: `infra/terraform#2423` with test and a small linter.
sso-bot: notifier: compliance webhook fired to PagerDuty incident INC-20260320-004.
sec-oncall: final note: treat all federated sessions as compromised until rotated. If you maintain any external integrations that rely on SAML, do an immediate rotate and validate. We'll post the postmortem in this thread within 48h. :lock:
